# Portfolio Workflow Rules

- Execute requested changes in one pass whenever feasible; avoid clarification loops unless fully blocked.
- Prioritize production-grade polish for documentation, app flow, and repository cleanliness.
- Keep project runnable end-to-end after edits (training pipeline + web app checks).
- Report all changes directly in chat with concrete file-level detail.
- Do not run git add, commit, or push unless explicitly requested.
- Prefer professional portfolio presentation in docs, including clear structure, visual polish, and practical setup steps.
